title: Page 1
summary: A memorandum (MQRI Document 21897) reports that a final examination of trained cats found the program impractical for the agency's highly specialized needs; training was possible but no use was seen under prevailing operating conditions. It acknowledges the feat as a scientific achievement, noting cats can be trained to move short distances and suggesting they could similarly be trained to approach targets.

title: Page 2
summary: The text is a fragment from a declassified-style document (MORI ID 21897).
